posts.text:
Republican leaders tried to pass a five-year extension of surveillance authority in the dead of night.

The bill does not enhance privacy protection.

It risks expanding the ability of the Trump administration to spy on the American people.

Unacceptable.

That’s why we just defeated the bill on the House Floor.

The House just passed bipartisan legislation to restore protections to Haitian migrants legally present in the U.S. that Donald Trump is trying to rip away.

Democrats are temporarily in the minority.

But we continue to get stuff done for the people.

House Democrats will advance a War Powers Resolution on the Floor today.

To end the reckless and costly Republican war of choice in the Middle East.

There is a lot to fix in America right now.

Republicans decided to spend the day celebrating legislation that rips away healthcare.

And plunges our country further into debt.

Video

The cost of living is out of control.

Gas prices have skyrocketed because of Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice.

And the Republican economy has been a disaster for everyday Americans.

The Republican One Big Ugly Bill ripped away healthcare from millions of Americans.

To provide massive tax breaks to their billionaire donors and explode the debt.

Disgraceful.

On Yom HaShoah, we commemorate the victims of the uniquely horrific crimes against humanity carried out by the Nazis and honor the six million Jewish lives lost.

And we stand with our Jewish brothers and sisters in the urgent fight to crush antisemitism.

#NeverAgain

JD Vance is being roasted throughout the world.

1. The peace agreement he tried to negotiate with Iran collapsed.

2. His candidate Viktor Orbán got crushed in Hungary.

3. Pope Leo is righteously spanking the Trump administration.

Really bad week for this guy and the extremists.

Video

Donald Trump shamefully attacked His Holiness Pope Leo XIV.

People of faith will never worship a wannabe King.

We worship an almighty GOD.

Far-right authoritarian Viktor Orbán has lost the election.

Trump sycophants and MAGA extremists in Congress are up next in November.

Winter is coming.

Republicans want to take away your healthcare to fund Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice in the Middle East.

Our position is simple. 

Get lost.
Statement on the Serious Accusations against Rep. Eric Swalwell.

Republicans must put patriotic duty over party loyalty.

And join House Democrats to pass a War Powers Resolution.

To stop Donald Trump's reckless war of choice in the Middle East. Immediately.

Video

We need a permanent end to Donald Trump’s reckless, costly and dangerous war of choice.

Nothing less is sufficient.

Video

Republicans must end their cult-like allegiance to Donald Trump.

For the good of the nation and the free world.

Congress must immediately end this reckless war of choice in Iran before Donald Trump plunges us into World War III.

It’s time for every single Republican to put patriotic duty over party and stop the madness.

Enough.

Republicans are threatening to cut Medicare and Medicaid.

To pay for Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice in the Middle East.

Get lost.
